newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj agreement seen Friday - cenbk.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj agreement seen Friday - cenbk.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank said it and the state of Rio de Janeiro were likely to announce later today an agreement on the future of Banerj, a bank Rio state had hoped to privatize on Thursday.
Alkimar Moura, the Central Bank's director of norms, told reporters the Central Bank would extend beyond a Friday deadline its management of Banerj if asked to do so by Rio officials.
Banerj had been scheduled to be privatized at an auction on Thursday and become the first of Brazil's state banks to be sold to the private sector.
But a court order put the auction on hold, the second time this month that the bank's privatization was delayed.

The Central Bank took over administration of Banerj and Sao Paulo's Banespa bank in December 1994. Earlier this year investment bank Bozano, Simonsen was hired to prepare Banerj for privatization. Rio officials have said they hope to privatize Banerj in Janaury.
